desc: Confirm the reduction: answer = max dp[i] over i<=R and A_i<=X, where dp[i] is LIS ending at i.
Design dp[i] via coordinate-compressed values and a max-Fenwick querying strictly-smaller values.
Design offline query handling: sort queries by X, positions by A_i, insert into Fenwick over indices, prefix-max up to R.
Implement the full solution with fast I/O.
Validate on both provided samples; outputs match expected.
Review complexity (O((N+Q) log N)), integer bounds (values up to 1e9 handled by compression), and output format.
